all_access.description: Intentionally empty: DP-B-01 — no credential is mapped to all_access, so a leaked API key cannot read every index on the cluster.

findmedi_api.description: Application read/write on the five app indices only.

findmedi_breakglass.description: DP-B-01: bound to a backend role, never a shared service user, so raw EHR access is attributable to a named human and appears in the audit log.
